LESSON: READING 7.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What information do we obtain from visuals?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly
2. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 7.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS
This lesson teaches Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals for Grade 8 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals above.
2. Explain Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What information do we obtain from visuals?
2. How can one interpret a visual correctly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly
2. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
